   b. If count ≥ 3 in last 30 lines → T2 advisory: append single line to wiki/log.md naming the highest-severity marker + flag A0 in issue title (T2).
   c. NEVER cat/awk/grep more than 30 lines in one go.
4. F4 heartbeat: ALWAYS append one line 'Multica Self-Watchdog heartbeat OK' to wiki/log.md (D4 append-only, single line, no full daemon log embedded).

- F3 bounded count (single integer)
- single-line heartbeat append verification (grep "Multica Self-Watchdog heartbeat OK" wiki/log.md)
